claim: Patchline ships a continuously-rebuilt camera-ready PDF whose every number is provenance-linked in CI. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the provenance-linked claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make provenance-linked-camera-ready-gate`.
